findings.title: Restore the explicit Use System Device transition setup in SET-017
findings.evidence: SET-B045 documents selecting Use System Device so Live output matches macOS Sound output choice. R1 SET-017 explicitly says select Use System Device and switch between two known working OS outputs. R2 replaces that sequence with inspect Driver Type and Use System Device, then two known productive OS Sound outputs. This only names inspections and no longer explicitly selects the option or changes the OS selection, while retaining the unchanged source claim/documentary following-OS role. Approved audit SETA-B045 assessed the old action as an explicit two-output switch, and G08 adds platform Driver Type/driver-owned entry contexts rather than removing that original setup.
findings.why_required: Inspection of an option and two devices does not exercise its conditional follow-OS selection relation. Refining the driver contexts must preserve the existing independently productive transition setup; otherwise the future case can omit the actual trigger while still being associated with the retained clause.
findings.minimal_correction: Preserve R2 before changes, then narrowly restore an explicit admitted macOS action: select Use System Device in Live, separately establish two known productive OS output baselines, switch OS Sound selection between those outputs and retain the named selection/state relation. Make the finite context unambiguous. Keep all audio/latency/failover/default/timing outcomes and actual target oracles unknown/null; no new clause, entitlement, driver installation or runtime is needed. Update only successor action/delta/snapshots/pins as applicable, with a bounded read-only check for this sequence.
findings.approval_condition: Independent focused rereview of preserved R2 bytes and the exact action/context correction; other approved partial/unknown scope unchanged.
